Title: ​​Cuisinart Propel+ Four Burner 3-In-1 Gas Grill​s recalled due to a laceration hazard
Product: Cuisinart Propel+ Four Burner 3-In-1 Gas Grills with Pizza Oven
What you should do: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Conair for a refund.Consumers should stop using the recalled Cuisinart Propel+ Four Burner 3-in-1 Gas Grill immediately and visit Conair’s website to check if their grill is included in the recall. If affected, follow the instructions to safely remove the tempered glass window on the pizza oven and upload two photographs; one of the removed glass and one of the grill’s serial number to the firm’s website.
